Name: Cheese Artistry Infused
Author: Yuzu17
Description:
[color=#ea9999][size=5][font=Courier New][b]Cheese Artistry Infused[/b][/font][/size][/color]
[font=Courier New][b][color=#efefef][size=4]Supports Cornucopia, Wildflour, SVE, RSV. [/size][/color][/b][/font]



[font=Courier New][b][color=#ea9999][size=5]New ingredients & items[/size][/color]
[b][color=#efefef][size=4]1. [/size][/color][/b][b][size=4][color=#ffd966]Rennet Collector[/color][/size][/b][b][color=#efefef][size=4] : Hold the Rennet Collector, stand next to a cow, and press the interaction button to collect rennet.
2. [/size][/color][/b][b][size=4][color=#ffd966]Rennet Extract[/color][/size][/b][b][color=#efefef][size=4] : An enzyme extract collected from cows. Add it to milk in a Cheese Press to turn the milk into cheese curds.
3. [/size][/color][/b][b][size=4][color=#ffd966]Marnie's Secret Blue Mold[/color][/size][/b][b][color=#efefef][size=4] : A blue mold that Marnie secretly cultivates for cheesemaking.[/size][/color][/b][/b][/font]
[font=Courier New][b][b][color=#efefef][size=4]4. [/size][/color][/b][b][size=4][color=#ffd966]Marnie's Secret White Mold[/color][/size][/b][b][color=#efefef][size=4] : A White mold that Marnie secretly cultivates for cheesemaking. [/size][/color][/b][/b][/font]
[font=Courier New][b][b][color=#efefef][size=4]5. [/size][/color][/b][b][size=4][color=#ffd966]Milk Cheese Curd[/color][/size][/b][b][color=#efefef][size=4] : Fresh cheese curds made by combining cow's milk and rennet in a Cheese Press. [/size][/color][/b][/b][/font]
[font=Courier New][b][b][color=#efefef][size=4]6. [/size][/color][/b][b][size=4][color=#ffd966]Goat Cheese Curd[/color][/size][/b][b][color=#efefef][size=4] : Fresh cheese curds made by combining goat's milk and rennet in a Cheese Press. [/size][/color][/b][/b][/font]
[font=Courier New][b][b][color=#efefef][size=4]7. [/size][/color][/b][b][size=4][color=#ffd966]Saltwater[/color][/size][/b][b][color=#efefef][size=4] : A special saltwater mixture made by combining water from the Secret Woods with salt in the kitchen. Used in cheesemaking to enhance flavor and aid the aging process. [/size][/color][/b][/b][/font]
[font=Courier New][b][b][color=#efefef][size=4]8. [/size][/color][/b][b][size=4][color=#ffd966]Cheese Aging Machine[/color][/size][/b][b][color=#efefef][size=4] : A special machine designed to age cheese slowly and carefully. [/size][/color][/b][/b][/font]



[font=Courier New][b][b][color=#00ffff][size=5]Installation instructions[/size][/color]
[size=4][color=#efefef]Download and unzip the file.[/color][/size]
[size=4][color=#efefef]Place the extracted folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder. [/color][/size][/b][/b][/font]

Manifest.Name: Cheese Artistry Infused
Manifest.Description: Collect rennet from each cow once a day with a keepsake from Lewis.
